integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo classical Lucas/Kummer results; standalone code tests 2600 exact integer residues and does not substitute for infinite proof. No independent scientific audit.
limitations: Specific to binomial(4n,n) modulo 3; no prime-power or arbitrary-cutoff leading-constant theorem. Earlier research already gives the unsigned nondivisibility support. Priority risk from general block-digit methods and unindexed exact specializations.
title: Sharp ternary signed-residue bias of four-ary Fuss–Catalan binomial numerators
